scope: Read-only engineering and four adopted-stage poster feasibility audit. No private backup read, source adoption, app edit, deployment or live save.

definitions.continue_independent: There is a concrete code/metadata/media route to attempt now without repeating user confirmation. It is not a promise that a third-party asset must exist.
definitions.park_until_new_evidence: Keep truthful fallback and wait for newly available evidence; do not repeat the same failed route.
definitions.retire_requirement: Stop treating the requirement as mandatory completion. Preserve source, score and all historical facts.

engineering.finding: Owner-only MCP route and native owner gate unchanged. One D1 batch reads target scores and the complete owner journal; response exposes emptiness and target log headers, not score values or notes. Zero stays nonempty. Envelope checks detect truncation, not authentication.
engineering.remaining: After a separately authorized release, verify actual connected-plugin discovery, owner successful call, nonowner denial and exact response decode. Current v203 does not expose the new tool.

engineering.canSolveIndependently: Technical work can be performed once authorized deployment and working owner connection exist; live success cannot be guaranteed today.
engineering.finding: Root audit observed IAB tab selection timeout; a past browser failure is not proof that the interface cannot work. Not deploying is current user scope, not an engineering incapability.
engineering.remaining: Try the actual existing authorized connector after release. Retain old bindings on any failure; no repeated per-song export demands. A single consolidated owner read remains a fallback, not a routine user step.

engineering.canSolveIndependently: Implementation and package validation yes; live owner state depends on authenticated channel.
engineering.finding: Local adoption receipts establish state at adoption only. Later release should still check current scores/journal/source preservation for changed bindings, plus access and owner checks. Do not treat old receipt freshness as current.
engineering.remaining: Perform one consolidated release-time protection check; do not invent source equality or extend export dates.

engineering.canSolveIndependently: Local transaction, concurrency and owner-save regressions are testable now; arbitrary production saves are not appropriate evidence.
engineering.canAbandon: Can retire a blanket requirement to rewrite a real personal score merely to test a read-only change; cannot drop owner safety or falsely mark actual save verified.
engineering.finding: The new endpoint is read-only; read-only live success/denial and no-write verification are sufficient for that endpoint. Existing save behavior must remain protected by regression checks and separately scoped production verification when save code changes.
Reviewed preflight, registry, MCP gate, importer and native-storage coverage. 28 targeted tests passed. This is bounded functional review, not an exhaustive security proof.

Full replay of every external video is not necessary to ship a data/readonly-tool update and is dependent on third-party access. Preserve exact user-confirmed scope and published limitations; continue targeted validation only when new evidence changes song/version/performer scope.
engineering.mustRetain: Accurate source identity, known adopted scope, honest not-played labels and failure fallbacks.
